Check out Smart Remote, an app to control your Smart TV from your phone:\n%1$s
Why doesn\'t my TV show up in the search?

The TV and phone need to be on the same Wi-Fi network. The search uses local multicast (SSDP/mDNS), which doesn\'t cross different networks (e.g. phone on mobile data, TV on Wi-Fi) and doesn\'t work if the router has "client isolation" (AP isolation) enabled. Make sure the TV is on and try searching again.
Why can\'t I open apps (Netflix, YouTube, etc.) on my Samsung TV?

Samsung silently disabled this feature on newer Tizen TVs (2022 onward). The remote control keys still work normally, only direct app launching stopped working. This isn\'t an issue specific to Smart Remote, and there\'s no confirmed free workaround at this time.
Do I need to pair again every time I open the app?

No. After the first pairing, the credential is saved on your phone (with security appropriate to the manufacturer) and reconnection happens automatically. You only need to pair again if the TV is factory reset, manually unpaired from the TV\'s side, or if the app is uninstalled.
Why does the TV sometimes disconnect on its own, and what does the app do about it?

This can happen due to Wi-Fi instability or the TV itself closing the connection due to inactivity. The app detects this and automatically tries to reconnect on its own. If automatic reconnection isn\'t possible (for example, if the TV requires pairing again), the app doesn\'t keep retrying by itself — to avoid flooding the TV screen with confirmation prompts — and you\'ll need to reconnect manually from the pairing screen.
Why does a streaming app show up disabled in my TV\'s app grid?

Not every app has a confirmed way to be launched automatically on every TV manufacturer/model. When that hasn\'t been confirmed, the app avoids guessing (which could open the wrong app) and shows that app as unavailable specifically on that TV.
Does the app work with the TV on a different network than the phone (mobile data, another Wi-Fi)?
No. Both search and control only happen on the local network. If your phone is on mobile data or a different Wi-Fi network than the TV, the app won\'t find or control the TV.
